analyst_view.overall: Málaga are bottom with 5 points and are the only La Liga side still without a win; they lost 1-0 at Osasuna on Sunday and have lost at home to Villarreal, Real Sociedad and Racing. Athletic, 8th under Edin Terzic, lost at home to Espanyol last time out and have no European games this week. The numbers have no team news for this match: Athletic are without strikers Guruzeta (cruciate ligament) and Sannadi (hamstring) plus centre-back Vivian, with Yeray and Yuri training apart and doubtful, and Berenguer, their top scorer with four, back in training. Málaga miss Lobete, Ochoa and Rafita, while Calero is back in training and Murillo is being checked after a blow at Pamplona; Aznou returns from a ban. No referee named yet.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.4 goals and know nothing about the absences here. Athletic have no fit specialist striker with Guruzeta and Sannadi out, which pulls their side down a little, while missing Vivian and maybe Yeray at the back could help a Málaga side that scores little. Guruzeta has been out since October, so Athletic's recent scoring (8 in 6, about as expected) partly reflects it already; I trim only slightly, to about 2.3.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.5 corners, with Málaga's low recent corner count already taken off. Athletic attack wide through Nico and Iñaki Williams and Berenguer, which keeps corners coming, and Málaga at home have to push for a first win. Nothing new points either way, so I stay at 10.5.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.3 cards, a fairly calm game by La Liga standards, with Athletic's recent cards already counted. The referee is not named yet, and neither side has a suspension issue: Málaga get Aznou back from a ban. A bottom side desperate for a win can get tense late on, but the numbers already know Málaga's position and form, so I stay at 4.3.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.9 shots, with both sides' recent shot counts already added; Athletic should take most of them. Their missing strikers change who shoots more than how often, since Terzic still has the Williams brothers, Berenguer and Sancet. I stay at 26.9.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.8 shots on target, with Málaga's better recent accuracy and Athletic's slightly worse accuracy already counted. Without Guruzeta and Sannadi Athletic lack a central finisher, but they have played that way for several weeks, which the recent form already shows. I stay at 8.8.
